subject.title: fix(telegram): suppress failure fallback when source delivery is message-tool-only

question: Which open Telegram `message_tool_only` fallback PR should be the canonical landing path after rebasing onto current main?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose between overlapping member/contributor PRs or accept the user-visible Telegram fallback invariant without maintainer intent, especially now that both branches are dirty against newer dispatcher changes.

options.title: Rebase One Canonical Guard
options.body: Pick this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90095, adapt the guard and test to current main's fallback predicate, land one, and close the other after merge.

options.title: Request Native Telegram Proof
options.body: Ask for a short Telegram Desktop or live Telegram proof before landing if maintainers want visual confirmation beyond source-level regression coverage.

options.title: Defer The Fallback Change
options.body: Keep both PRs open only if maintainers are not ready to accept the `message_tool_only` suppression invariant for skipped or failed automatic final delivery.

recommendation.title: Rebase One Canonical Guard
recommendation.body: Pick this PR or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90095, adapt the guard and test to current main's fallback predicate, land one, and close the other after merge.
